messages:
maya: Heads-up — docs build failed after the theme migration. linkcheck shows a bunch of broken anchors, e.g. /guides/serving#gpu-tiling and /api/params#max-seq-length :

docs-bot: CI: docs/linkcheck job failed (exit code 1) — 14 broken anchors detected. See <https://ci.redwood.dev/1234|linkcheck logs>. :warning:

olivia: I think this is the frontmatter -> slug normalization change from the new mkdocs theme. It used to keep slashes, now it converts nested headings to hyphens.

maya: Any quick remediation ideas? We have a customer-facing changelog page that links to those anchors.

raj: short fix: generate redirects for old anchors. We can add an html redirect anchor list into extra/templates or use a small post-build script to inject old anchors back.

olivia: Or update the source links to the new normalized anchors — but that touches ~40 files. Might be safer to patch build to restore old anchor ids.

tony: here's a tiny Python snippet that maps old ids -> new ids and inserts empty anchor tags during build. pretty safe: 
```python
import re,sys
map = {"gpu-tiling":"guides-serving-gpu-tiling","max-seq-length":"api-params-max-seq-length"}
text = sys.stdin.read()
for old,new in map.items():
    text = re.sub(rf"id=\"{new}\"", f'id="{new}\" data-old-id="{old}"', text)
print(text)
```

raj: alternatively a sed one-liner if you prefer: 
```bash
sed -E 's/id="guides-serving-gpu-tiling"/id="guides-serving-gpu-tiling" data-old-id="gpu-tiling"/g' -i html/*.html
```

olivia: We should avoid touching generated HTML in repo; put this in docs-build step in our buildpack. Add stage after mkdocs build: `python inject_old_ids.py < site/*.html > site_fixed/*.html` and run linkcheck against site_fixed.

maya: Good. Who can open the PR with the script + CI change? We'll need approvals from @olivia and @raj.

raj: I can do the PR. plan: branch docs/fix-anchor-compat-179123 and add a test that ensures linkcheck passes on sample pages. I'll also add a short README in docs/tools.

olivia: Please make the script idempotent and add a small unit test. Use the same map file we generate from parsing mkdocs nav (so future renames are tracked). Also add a short note in the migration guide about the theme change.

tony: If you want, I can run the patched build on the canary site after the PR merges. I'll coordinate with infra for a quick preview build.

maya: Perfect. raj please assign olivia + me as reviewers. tag release-team for the changelog link update.

raj: Will do. Opening PR in ~10m. PR will also contain a small grep command to find other manual links: `rg "#([a-z0-9-]+)\)" docs/ --only-matching`

olivia: :thumbsup: Thanks — this will prevent churn.

maya: Closing loop — once PR merges, we should run full linkcheck across all translated locales too. Marking follow-up in #docs post-merge.

docs-bot: CI: PR opened by raj: <https://ci.redwood.dev/pr/4567|docs/fix-anchor-compat-179123> — linkcheck job queued.

tony: LGTM on the plan. I'll stand by for preview build.
